operating_notes.text: Won ₹35.89 Cr FCI Smart Warehousing Project for 150 depots involving IoT, AI, and surveillance.
Project execution timeline is 180 days with 3 years of AMC support.
Recommended final dividend of Re 0.50 per equity share for FY26.
Brand business achieved ₹369.61 Cr in FY26 (India: ₹231.98 Cr, Outside India: ₹137.6 Cr).
Short-term borrowings include ₹171 Cr under MSME supply chain trade financing platform at 8-9% interest rate.
Received Advance Work Order (AWO) from BSNL for BharatNet Middle Mile Network Project in Odisha Telecom Circle valued at approx ₹3,194.83 Cr.
Incorporated two wholly owned step-down subsidiaries: Secure Connection, LLC (USA) and Sai'an Zhilian (Shenzhen) Technology Co., Ltd. (China).
Brand Business contributed 19.03% and Market Entry Specialist contributed 80.97% to consolidated segmental revenue in Q2FY27.

timeline.summary: Secured a ₹35.89 Cr order from Food Corporation of India for a Smart Warehousing Project across 150 depots.
